title: W12 Mac references: the sidebar's top row and hiding the sidebar
about: The top row (the sidebar toggle, back, forward and reload) for helix/W12-top-row. Kite for Mac from origin/main: W12 changes no Mac code. The sessions are windows/helix/states on origin/helix/W12-top-row. The frames below are the top row's SymbolButtons: the toggle at 71, back, forward and reload ending 6pt short of the sidebar's 240.

states.name: rest
states.holds: the top row at rest on example.com: the toggle at 0.6, back and forward disabled (0.125), reload enabled

states.name: loading
states.holds: reload is the X while https://httpbin.org/delay/10 loads (it answers after 10 s; the capture comes about 3 s after launch); back and forward disabled
states.unverified: the X shows only while the runner reaches httpbin.org and it hasn't answered yet: if the capture shows reload's arrow, the page had already loaded (or failed at once)

states.name: history
states.holds: back enabled, forward disabled, after the page has gone somewhere
states.skip: needs a page with history: a session can't carry any (Chromium reloads a restored tab without its history), session URLs are public http(s) only, and the steps can't navigate (no keys, no Return, text only into the command bar). Windows' capture holds the state with --page-status back

states.name: hover
states.holds: the pointer resting on reload: no change to the button (SymbolButton has no hoverOpacity or hoverWash in the top row), and its Reload tooltip after AppKit's delay
states.skip: the tooltip needs a real pointer resting on the button, and kite ui input has no plain move; the button itself draws no hover

states.name: hidden
states.holds: after the toggle (Hide Sidebar): no sidebar, the card from 10pt in, the traffic lights where they were
states.skip: needs a click on the toggle (a SymbolButton, not in SAFE_TARGETS: the class is shared with the header's More and Developer buttons, whose menus have no test hook) or ⌘S (keys are refused). A safe target for the toggle alone (its accessibility label, Toggle Sidebar) would let this run: click [87, 23.5]

states.name: shown-again
states.holds: after Hide Sidebar and Show Sidebar: the same as rest
states.skip: as hidden, and the hidden sidebar's toggle is off the window, so showing it again needs ⌘S (keys are refused) or the hover reveal
